decisions.summary: print format before each fetch (cache hit included); pending line after each FETCHED save; QUESTION passed by WHOLE=1; excerpt bundle --no-ledger
decisions.why: FR-003 and spec D1 as accepted.

decisions.summary: a URL already FETCHED in the same OUT is neither fetched nor printed
decisions.why: The brief itself ties the print to a fetch ('printed before a page is fetched again') and FR-003 says 'BEFORE fetching it'; the existing feature-250 D15 behavior does no fetch and no cache read for such a URL, and the save that put it in OUT already printed its ledger lines. Implied by the GM's own words.

reserve URL= writes stub with h3 and pointer line and a cited line; fill pass run by make record (not under CHECK=1) and by the lookup, idempotent
decisions.why: FR-005 and spec D2; CHECK=1 is already a write-nothing mode.

decisions.summary: cache layout under <mirror>/.specify/page-cache, atomic rename under lock, OUT filled by copying, manifest note says from cache
decisions.why: FR-008 and the edge cases; copying keeps OUT's names and shape.

decisions.summary: age = seven days; REFRESH read from the environment
decisions.why: FR-009 asks for a stated age with its reason; both are stated.

decisions.summary: CachedPages wraps Pages for source-pages, every check-bundle mode and quote-verbatim; failures never cached
decisions.why: FR-008, FR-010, the fetch-failure edge case.

decisions.summary: quote-verbatim refetches (once) a page whose cached copy is an imported, non-exact saved form, and replaces the entry with exact text
decisions.why: Narrows FR-010/SC-005 ('no fetch for a cached page') for imported copies only. An imported copy is the wrapped saved form, which inserts line breaks after every '.', '!' or '?' followed by a non-space (the committed _source_pages.wrapped), so after quote-verbatim's whitespace squeeze '3.5' reads '3. 5' and a verbatim quote can fail or be judged against altered text; parts cut long lines mid-text. Using it would defeat quote-verbatim's own purpose (a character-for-character check). The refetch happens once per imported page and the cache then serves it, so the cache's purpose is kept.

decisions.summary: seed one line per URL/feature/session with first read time, read count, up to three questions of 200 chars, cited:<key> else unknown-outcome; idempotent
decisions.why: FR-007; the spec's Key Entities already give a seeded line a 'reads' field, so aggregation of reads is anticipated, and every URL is still seeded.

decisions.summary: import only FETCHED, on-disk, non-EXCERPT saves, newest per normalized URL, exact:false; a URL already cached left alone
decisions.why: Narrows SC-006 ('each distinct page of /tmp/l7r-check') by skipping pages saved only as excerpts or missing from disk. The spec's own edge case says the cache holds the WHOLE page; importing an excerpt as the page would hand every later whole-page read a cut page, defeating the cache. A file not on disk cannot be imported. Each case is separately justified; both implied by the spec's definition of a cache entry.
